Overview

This feature service provides a terrestrial Sensitive Ecosystem Inventory development permit area for the District of Peachland. It supports land use and environmental planning by outlining mapped areas associated with ecosystem sensitivity and development permit administration.

Feature Layer

Terrestrial SEI Development Permit Area (PCH) contains polygon features representing the mapped development permit area related to terrestrial Sensitive Ecosystem Inventory considerations. The layer is suitable for reviewing permit boundaries, supporting development review, and incorporating ecological sensitivity into planning workflows.

Geographic Coverage

The service covers the district of Peachland area within the Regional District of Central Okanagan.

Use Cases

  • Development permit review and planning
  • Environmental and ecosystem sensitivity assessment
  • Municipal and regional land use mapping
  • Public and internal GIS reference for permit areas

Source and Use

The data is owned by the district of Peachland,  provided by the GIS Section of the Regional District of Central Okanagan and is licensed under the Regional District of Central Okanagan Open Data License.
